items.summary: Recommendation: continue measurement only with source-dated impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, site-attributed commission, and available AI cost. Do not interpret missing revenue, attribution, margin, ROI, causal lift, or operational data as zero. Smallest next step: record the next scheduled observations and compare actual deltas with acceptance thresholds.

Recommendation: preserve containment-only execution this cycle. Evidence: 191 approved proposals lack execution, 48 failure follow-ups remain open, 25 deployed improvements await measurement, and only 1 outcome is proven in the 30-day scorecard. Revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: $4.92 aggregate commission and $0 site-attributed; ROI, margin, causal lift, and cost-to-learn are unknown. No unblocked implementation candidate exists, so no new change_request is justified. Smallest next step: reconcile existing work, measure deployed changes, and document repair-or-close decisions. Owner decision: authorize sending the prepared permission request, or keep it unsent.

Recommendation: keep the gated product private. Official source documentation confirms API access mechanics but not rights for public or commercial display, storage, derivatives, caching, alerts, or monetization; legal, security, accuracy, privacy, attribution, and measurement gates remain incomplete. Smallest next step: attach the consolidated read-only rights, data-flow, retention, consent, vendor, and incident evidence without sending outreach.
